intervals.quote: The new ``Direct search Experiment for Light dark matter'', DELight, will be using superfluid helium as active target, instrumented with magnetic micro-calorimeters.

website.quote: The DELight experiment harnesses the combined expertise of Heidelberg University (UHD), the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT), the University of Freiburg (UFR), and Imperial College London (ICL)

summary.plain: The German-led team (Heidelberg, Karlsruhe, Freiburg and Imperial College) building DELight, a dark matter search with superfluid helium.
summary.technical: Collaboration of Heidelberg University, KIT, the University of Freiburg and Imperial College London (spokesperson B. von Krosigk, Heidelberg); funded by DFG Research Unit 6006, HEiKA and the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation.
